questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Back Titration of Excess Reagent Mixtures
questions.category: Mole Concept & Stoichiometry :: Quantitative & Structural Chemistry (Type 1)
questions.question: In [Mole Concept & Stoichiometry], a $100\text{ mL}$ mixture of $0.1\text{ M } \text{FeSO}_4$ and $0.1\text{ M } \text{Fe}_2(\text{SO}_4)_3$ is completely oxidized in acidic medium. What volume (in $\text{mL}$) of $0.02\text{ M } \text{KMnO}_4$ is required?
questions.solution: Only $\text{Fe}^{2+}$ is oxidized by $\text{KMnO}_4$. Moles of $\text{Fe}^{2+} = 0.1\text{ L} \times 0.1\text{ M} = 0.01\text{ mol}$. Equivalents of $\text{Fe}^{2+} = 0.01 \times 1 = 0.01$. In acidic medium, $\text{Mn}^{7+} + 5e^- \to \text{Mn}^{2+}$ ($n$-factor $= 5$). Normality of $\text{KMnO}_4 = 0.02 \times 5 = 0.1\text{ N}$. Volume required $= \frac{0.01\text{ eq}}{0.1\text{ N}} = 0.1\text{ L} = 100\text{ mL}$.
questions.explanation: Analyze using fundamental chemical principles in Mole Concept & Stoichiometry.
tags: Back Titration of Excess Reagent Mixtures

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.category: Mole Concept & Stoichiometry :: Quantitative & Structural Chemistry (Type 4)
questions.question: In [Mole Concept & Stoichiometry], a $100\text{ mL}$ mixture of $0.1\text{ M } \text{FeSO}_4$ and $0.1\text{ M } \text{Fe}_2(\text{SO}_4)_3$ is completely oxidized in acidic medium. What volume (in $\text{mL}$) of $0.02\text{ M } \text{KMnO}_4$ is required?
questions.solution: Only $\text{Fe}^{2+}$ is oxidized by $\text{KMnO}_4$. Moles of $\text{Fe}^{2+} = 0.1\text{ L} \times 0.1\text{ M} = 0.01\text{ mol}$. Equivalents of $\text{Fe}^{2+} = 0.01 \times 1 = 0.01$. In acidic medium, $\text{Mn}^{7+} + 5e^- \to \text{Mn}^{2+}$ ($n$-factor $= 5$). Normality of $\text{KMnO}_4 = 0.02 \times 5 = 0.1\text{ N}$. Volume required $= \frac{0.01\text{ eq}}{0.1\text{ N}} = 0.1\text{ L} = 100\text{ mL}$.
questions.explanation: Analyze using fundamental chemical principles in Mole Concept & Stoichiometry.

questions.category: Mole Concept & Stoichiometry :: Quantitative Chemistry
questions.question: How many moles of electrons are transferred per mole of dichromate ion $(\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-})$ during its complete reduction to $\text{Cr}^{3+}$ in acidic medium in [Mole Concept & Stoichiometry]?
questions.solution: Each $\text{Cr}$ atom changes oxidation state from $+6$ to $+3$ (3 electrons). For $\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-}$ containing two chromium atoms, total electrons transferred $= 2 \times 3 = 6$.
questions.explanation: Calculate using quantitative laws in Mole Concept & Stoichiometry.
